privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: TradeMaster respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
privacyPolicy.section1Text: We collect your name, email address, phone number, business details, location data, and any content you upload to create your business profile.
privacyPolicy.section2Text: We use your information to provide the business-directory service, display your public profile, communicate with you, and improve the platform.
privacyPolicy.section3Text: We do not sell your personal information. Business contact details you choose to display are public to directory visitors. We may disclose information when required by law.
privacyPolicy.section4Text: We retain your data as long as your account is active. You can request account deletion at any time from your profile settings. After deletion, personal identifiers are purged in accordance with our retention schedule.
privacyPolicy.section5Text: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. Contact us through the platform for data-portability or deletion requests.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: Welcome to TradeMaster. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to these terms.
termsOfService.section1Text: TradeMaster provides a local business directory that lets users discover businesses, view profiles, and contact business owners.
termsOfService.section2Text: You are responsible for keeping your password secure and for all activity under your account. You must provide accurate and lawful information.
termsOfService.section3Text: You may not use the platform for illegal activity, harassment, fraud, or to upload harmful or infringing content.
termsOfService.section4Text: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time from your profile settings.
termsOfService.section5Text: TradeMaster is provided "as is". We are not liable for disputes between users and businesses or for inaccurate business information provided by users.
